notes: Version 2.59 records the O6/O4 correction in O6 1.2, O7 1.16, O8 1.1 and the Span-Growth Note 2.2. O4 is reported in its own terms: no bound on β follows from the bounded-flux and Cheeger argument, and its candidate would read β ≤ 2 in the raw exponent of O3, not β ≤ 1. The square-root growth inequality dp/dn ≲ c_BI √p(n) is an unestablished hypothesis (G) of O6, and the O6 conversion law β_eff = 1/(1/2 + α) is conditional on (G) and on the power-law redundancy Ansatz.
